verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no managed Slurm or Kubernetes scheduling for Paperspace. Paperspace offers VMs, Notebooks, Deployments (containers-as-a-service) and Workflows (ML pipelines), which are adjacent features rather than a managed cluster scheduler. The Kubernetes 1-Click App material describes DigitalOcean Marketplace, a separate parent-platform product, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can schedule jobs on managed Slurm or Kubernetes instead of building my own scheduler on raw nodes
